s.d: μέν, conjunctive particle (originally a form of μήν), usually related to a following δέ or other adversative conjunction, and distinguishing the word or clause with which it stands from that which follows. It is generally untranslatable and is not nearly so frequent in NT as in cl. Like δέ, it never stands first in a clause. 1. Answered by δέ or some other particle: μὲν . . . δέ, indeed . . . but, [[matthew 3 11|Mat.3:11]], [[luke 3 16|Luk.3:16]], al.; with pronouns, ὃς μὲν . . . ὃς δέ, one . . . another, [[matthew 21 35|Mat.21:35]], al.; pl., [[philippians 1 16|Php.1:16, 17]]; ὃ μὲν . . . ὃ δὲ . . . ὃ δέ, some . . . some . . . some, [[matthew 13 8|Mat.13:8;]] τοῦτο μὲν . . . τοῦτο δέ, partly . . . partly, [[hebrews 10 33|Heb.10:33;]] μὲν . . . ἔπειτα, [[john 11 6|Jhn.11:6;]] μὲν . . . καί, [[luke 8 5|Luk.8:5.]] 2. μέν solitarium, answered by no other particle: πρῶτον μέν (Bl., l.with), [[romans 1 8|Rom.1:8 3:2]], [[1-corinthians 11 18|1Co.11:18]]; μὲν οὖν in narrative, summing up what precedes or introducing something further (Bl., §78, 5), so then, rather, nay rather: [[luke 11 28|Luk.11:28]] (WH, μενοῦν), [[acts 1 6|Act.1:6 9:31]], al.; μὲν οὖν γε ([[philippians 3 8|Php.3:8]], WH): see: μενοῦνγε. (AS)
μεν-οῦν-γε = μὲν οὖν γε nay rather: [[romans 9 20|Rom.9:20 10:18]], [[philippians 3 8|Php.3:8]].† (AS)
μέν-τοι = μέν τοι, yet, however: [[john 4 27|Jhn.4:27]], al.; εἰ μ., [[james 2 8|Jas.2:8]] (if indeed). (AS)

μένω, [in LXX for קוּם ,עמד, etc. ;] to stay, abide, remain. 1. Intrans.; (i) of place: before ἐν, [[luke 8 27|Luk.8:27]], al.; παρά, with dative of person(s), [[john 1 40|Jhn.1:40]], al; σύν, [[luke 1 56|Luk.1:56;]] καθ᾽ ἑαυτόν, [[acts 28 16|Act.28:16;]] with adv., ἐκεῖ, [[matthew 10 11|Mat.10:11;]] ὧδε, [[matthew 26 38|Mat.26:38;]] metaphorically, [[1-john 2 18|1Jn.2:18;]] of the Holy Spirit, [[john 1 32|Jhn.1:32, 33 14:17]]; of Christ, [[john 6 56|Jhn.6:56 15:4]], al.; ὁ θεός, [[1-john 4 15|1Jn.4:15]], conversely, of Christians, [[john 6 56|Jhn.6:56 15:4]], [[1-john 4 15|1Jn.4:15]], al.; ὁ λόγος τ. θεοῦ, [[1-john 2 14|1Jn.2:14;]] ἡ ἀλήθεια, II Jo 2, al. (ii) Of time; (a) of persons: [[philippians 1 25|Php.1:25;]] before εἰς τ. αἰῶνα, [[john 12 34|Jhn.12:34]], [[hebrews 7 24|Heb.7:24]], [[1-john 2 17|1Jn.2:17]]; ὀλίγον, [[revelation 17 10|Rev.17:10;]] ἕως ἔρχομαι, [[john 21 22|Jhn.21:22, 23]]; (b) of things, lasting or enduring: cities, [[matthew 11 23|Mat.11:23]], [[hebrews 13 14|Heb.13:14]]; λόγος θεοῦ, [[1-peter 1 23|1Pe.1:23;]] ἁμαρτία, [[john 9 41|Jhn.9:41.]] (iii) Of condition: with pred., μόνος, [[john 12 24|Jhn.12:24;]] ἄγαμος, [[1-corinthians 7 11|1Co.7:11;]] πιστός, [[2-timothy 2 13|2Ti.2:13;]] ἱερεύς, [[hebrews 7 3|Heb.7:3;]] with adv., οὕτως, [[1-corinthians 7 40|1Co.7:40;]] ὡς κἀγώ, ib. 8; before ἐν, ib. 20, 24. 2. Trans. (Bl., §34, 1; Field, Notes, 132): with accusative of person(s), [[acts 20 5|Act.20:5, 23]] (cf. ἀνα-, δια-, ἐν-, ἐπι-, κατα-, παρα-, συν-παρα-, περι-, προσ-, ὑπο-μένω). (AS)

μερίζω (μέρος), [in LXX chiefly for חָלַק ;] to divide; (a) to divide into parts : metaphorically, pass., [[1-corinthians 7 34|1Co.7:34]] (WH, R, ing.), [[1-corinthians 7 34|1Co.7:34]] (Rec., R, txt.) ( reading and punctuation, see ICC, in l); μεμέρισται ὁ Χριστός, [[1-corinthians 1 13|1Co.1:13;]] as in late authors, of factional division (cf. Polyb., viii, 23, 9), καθ᾽ ἑαυτοῦ, [[matthew 12 25|Mat.12:25;]] ἐφ᾽ εαυτόν, [[matthew 12 26|Mat.12:26]], [[mark 3 24|Mrk.3:24-26]]; (b) to distribute: with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), [[mark 6 41|Mrk.6:41;]] as in later usage (cf. Polyb., xi, 28, 9), to bestow: [[romans 12 3|Rom.12:3]], [[1-corinthians 7 17|1Co.7:17]], [[2-corinthians 10 13|2Co.10:13]], [[hebrews 7 2|Heb.7:2]]; mid., with accusative of thing(s) before μετά, [[luke 12 13|Luk.12:13]] (cf. δια-, συμ-μερίζω).† (AS)

μέριμνα, -ης, ἡ [in LXX: [[psalms 55 22|Psa.55:22]] (יְהַב), [[job 11 18|Job.11:18]], Sir.30:24, al ;] (in cl. chiefly poët.) care, anxiety: [[1-peter 5 7|1Pe.5:7;]] pl., [[luke 8 14|Luk.8:14 21:34]]; with genitive obj., [[matthew 13 22|Mat.13:22]], [[mark 4 19|Mrk.4:19]], [[2-corinthians 11 28|2Co.11:28]].† (AS)

μεριμνάω, -ῶ (μέριμνα), [in LXX: [[psalms 38 18|Psa.38:18]] (דָּאַג), etc. ;] 1. to be anxious: absol., [[matthew 6 27|Mat.6:27, 31]], [[luke 12 25|Luk.12:25]]; μηδὲν μ., [[philippians 4 6|Php.4:6;]] with dative of thing(s), [[matthew 6 25|Mat.6:25]], [[luke 12 22|Luk.12:22]]; before περί, [[matthew 6 28|Mat.6:28]], [[luke 10 41|Luk.10:41 12:26]]; πῶς, [[matthew 10 19|Mat.10:19]], [[luke 12 11|Luk.12:11]]; εἰς τὴν αὔριον, [[matthew 6 34|Mat.6:34.]] 2. to care for: with accusative, τὰ τ. κυριου, [[1-corinthians 7 32|1Co.7:32-34;]] τὰ τ. κόσμου, [[1-corinthians 7 34|1Co.7:34;]] τὰ περί ὑμῶν, [[philippians 2 20|Php.2:20;]] before ὑπέρ, [[1-corinthians 12 25|1Co.12:25;]] with genitive (a construction otherwise unknown), ἑαυτῆς (WH; τὰ ἑ. Rec.; see Bl., § 35, 7), [[matthew 6 34|Mat.6:34]] (cf. προ-μεριμνάω).† (AS)

μερίς, -ίδος, ἡ [in LXX chiefly חֵלֶק, חֶלְקָה ;] 1. (as in cl.) a part, portion: [[luke 10 42|Luk.10:42]], [[acts 8 21|Act.8:21]], [[2-corinthians 6 15|2Co.6:15]], [[colossians 1 12|Col.1:12]]. 2. In later Gk (see MM, xvi), as geographical term, a division, district: [[acts 16 12|Act.16:12.]]† (AS)

μερισμός, -οῦ, ὁ (μερίζω), [in LXX for מַחְלְקָה, מַחֲלֹקֶת, [[joshua 11 23|Jos.11:23]], [[esther 6 18|Est.6:18]] * ;] 1. a dividing, division: ψυχῆς κ. πνεύματος (i.e. between them or of the things themselves, see Westc., in l), [[hebrews 4 12|Heb.4:12.]] 2. a dis­tribution, bestowal (cf. μερίζω, 2); pl., [[hebrews 2 4|Heb.2:4.]]† (AS)
μεριστής, -οῦ, ὁ (μερίζω), a divider: [[luke 12 14|Luk.12:14.]]† (AS)

μέρος, -ους, τό (μείρομαι), [in LXX chiefly for קָצֶה ;] 1. a part, share, portion: [[john 13 8|Jhn.13:8]], [[acts 19 27|Act.19:27]] (Page, in l), [[revelation 20 6|Rev.20:6 22:19]]; hence (cl.), lot, destiny, [[matthew 24 51|Mat.24:51]], [[luke 12 46|Luk.12:46]], [[revelation 21 8|Rev.21:8]]. 2. a part as opposite to the whole : [[luke 11 36|Luk.11:36]], [[john 19 23|Jhn.19:23]], [[acts 5 2|Act.5:2 23:6]], [[ephesians 4 16|Eph.4:16]], [[revelation 16 19|Rev.16:19]]; with genitive (of the whole), [[luke 15 12|Luk.15:12 24:42]]; τ. Φαρισαίων, [[acts 23 9|Act.23:9;]] pl., [[john 21 6|Jhn.21:6;]] of the divisions of a province, [[matthew 2 22|Mat.2:22]], [[acts 2 10|Act.2:10 19:1 20:2]]; of the regions belonging to a city, [[matthew 15 21|Mat.15:21 16:13]], [[mark 8 10|Mrk.8:10]]; with genitive appos., [[ephesians 4 9|Eph.4:9;]] in adverbial phrases, ἀνὰ (κατὰ) μέρος, [[1-corinthians 14 27|1Co.14:27]], [[hebrews 9 5|Heb.9:5]]; μέρος τι, ἀπὸ μ., in part, [[romans 11 25|Rom.11:25 15:15, 24]], [[1-corinthians 11 18|1Co.11:18]], [[2-corinthians 1 14|2Co.1:14 2:5]]; ἐκ μ., [[1-corinthians 12 27|1Co.12:27 13:9 13:12]]; τὸ ἐκ μ., [[1-corinthians 13 10|1Co.13:10]] 3. A class or category (in cl. usually ἐν μ. τιθέναι, λαβεῖν, etc.) :ἐν μ., in respect of, [[colossians 2 16|Col.2:16;]] ἐν τ. μ, τούτῳ, in this respect, [[2-corinthians 3 10|2Co.3:10 9:3]].† (AS)

μεσημβρία, -ας, ἡ (μέσος, ἡμέρα), [in LXX chiefly for צֹהַר, [[genesis 3 16|Gen.3:16]], al; also for נֶגֶב, Dan LXX 8:4, 9, al. ;] 1. noon: [[acts 22 6|Act.22:6.]] 2. the South: [[acts 8 26|Act.8:26.]]† (AS)
μεσιτεύω (μεσίτης), to interpose, mediate: ὅρκῳ, [[hebrews 6 17|Heb.6:17]] (MM, ii, 111).† (AS)

μεσίτης, -ου, ὁ (μέσος), [in LXX: [[job 9 33|Job.9:33]] (בֵּין)* ;] an arbitrator, mediator: [[galatians 3 19|Gal.3:19;]] with dupl. genitive of person(s), θεοῦ κ. ἀνθρώπων, [[1-timothy 2 5|1Ti.2:5;]] with genitive of thing(s), διαθήκης, [[hebrews 8 6|Heb.8:6 9:15 12:24]]; ὁ δε μ. ἑνὸς οὐκ ἔστιν, [[galatians 3 20|Gal.3:20]] (see Lft., in l; and for exx. of this word in π., see MM, xvi).† (AS)

μεσο-νύκτιος (on seel, μεσα-, see Bl., § 6, 2), -ον (μέσος, νύξ), [in LXX chiefly for לַיִל חֵצִי ;] of or at midnight; as subst., neut., τὸ μ., midnight (Arist. and late writers) : genitive, [[luke 11 5|Luk.11:5;]] μέχρι μ., [[acts 20 7|Act.20:7;]] κατὰ τὸ μ., [[acts 16 25|Act.16:25;]] accusative (Rec., genitive; see Bl., § 34, 8), [[mark 13 35|Mrk.13:35.]]† μεσανύκτιον, see. μεσονύκτιος (AS)
Μεσοποταμία, -ας, ἡ (sc. χώρα) Mesopotamia: [[acts 2 9|Act.2:9 7:2]].† (AS)

μέσος, -η, -ον [in LXX chiefly for תָּוֶךְ ;] middle, in the middle or midst; 1. prop., as an adj.: [[luke 23 45|Luk.23:45]], [[john 19 18|Jhn.19:18]], [[acts 1 18|Act.1:18]]; with genitive pl., [[luke 22 55|Luk.22:55]], [[john 1 26|Jhn.1:26]]; genitive temp. (Bl., § 36, 13), μέσης νυκτός, [[matthew 25 6|Mat.25:6;]] μ. ἡμέρας, [[acts 26 13|Act.26:13.]] 2. In adverbial phrases, neut., μέσον, τὸ μ., as subst.: ἀνὰ μέσον, with genitive, between (cl.; in LXX: [[genesis 1 4|Gen.1:4]], al.), elliptically (but see M, Pr., 99), [[1-corinthians 6 5|1Co.6:5;]] = ἐν μ., among, in the midst of (El., § 39, 2; 40, 8; cf. in LXX: [[joshua 19 1|Jos.19:1]], Sir.27:2), [[matthew 13 25|Mat.13:25]], [[mark 7 31|Mrk.7:31]], [[revelation 7 17|Rev.7:17]]; διὰ μέσου, with genitive, [[luke 4 30|Luk.4:30;]] διὰ μέσον (Rec. -ου, see 81., § 42, 1), between, [[luke 17 11|Luk.17:11]] (ICC, in l); εἰς τὸ μ. (see: εἰς), [[mark 3 3|Mrk.3:3]], [[luke 4 35|Luk.4:35 5:19 6:8]], [[john 20 19|Jhn.20:19, 26]]; εἰς μ., [[mark 14 60|Mrk.14:60;]] ἐν τῷ μ., [[matthew 14 6|Mat.14:6;]] ἐν μ., [[joshua 8 3|Jos.8:3]], 9, [[acts 4 7|Act.4:7]]; with, genitive loc., [[mark 6 47|Mrk.6:47]], [[luke 21 21|Luk.21:21 22:55]], [[acts 17 22|Act.17:22]], [[hebrews 2 12|Heb.2:12]]" (LXX), [[revelation 4 6|Rev.4:6 5:6 22:2]]. with genitive pl., [[matthew 10 16|Mat.10:16 18:2, 20]], [[mark 9 36|Mrk.9:36]], [[luke 2 46|Luk.2:46 8:7 10:3 22:27 24:36]], [[acts 1 15|Act.1:15 2:22 27:21]], [[1-thessalonians 2 7|1Th.2:7]], [[revelation 1 13|Rev.1:13 2:1 5:6 6:6]]; κατὰ μέσον τ. νυκτός, [[acts 27 27|Act.27:27]] (Bl., § 47, 6); ἐκ τοῦ μ. (Lft., in l; Deiss., BS, 252 f.), [[colossians 2 14|Col.2:14;]] ἐκ μ.., [[2-thessalonians 2 7|2Th.2:7;]] ἐκ τοῦ μ., with genitive, [[matthew 13 49|Mat.13:49]], [[acts 17 33|Act.17:33 23:10]], [[1-corinthians 5 2|1Co.5:2]], [[2-corinthians 6 17|2Co.6:17]]. 3. Neut., μέσον, adverbially, with genitive, in the midst of, [[matthew 14 24|Mat.14:24]] (WH, txt., R, mg., aliter), [[philippians 2 15|Php.2:15]] (διὰ μέσου­see supr.-also [[john 8 50|Jhn.8:50]], R, mg.).† (AS)
μεσότοιχον, -ου, τό (μέσος, τοῖχος) a partition wall: [[ephesians 2 14|Eph.2:14]] (not elsewhere, but see LS, see word μεσότοιχος).† (AS)
μεσουράνημα, -τος, τό (μεσουρανέω, to be in mid-heaven, of the sun at the meridian), the zenith, mid-heaven: [[revelation 8 13|Rev.8:13 14:6 19:17]].† (AS)

μεσόω, -ῶ (μέσός), [in LXX: μεσούσης τ. νυκός, [[exodus 12 29|Exo.12:29]] (חֵצִי), etc. ;] to be in the middle, esp. of time: τ. ἑορτῆς μεσούσης, in the middle of the feast, [[john 7 14|Jhn.7:14.]]† (AS)
Μεσσίας, -ου, ὁ (Aram. מְשִׁיחָא = Heb. מָשִׁיחַ = Χριστός, which see), Messiah: [[john 1 42|Jhn.1:42 4:22]].† (AS)

μεστός, -ή, -όν [in LXX: [[nahum 1 10|Nam.1:10]], [[ezekiel 37 1|Eze.37:1]] (מָלֵא), [[esther 5 2|Est.5:2]], [[proverbs 6 34|Pro.6:34]] * ;] full: with genitive of thing(s), [[john 19 29|Jhn.19:29 21:11]], [[james 3 8|Jas.3:8]]; metaphorically, of thoughts and feelings, [[matthew 23 28|Mat.23:28]], [[romans 1 29|Rom.1:29 15:14]], [[2-peter 2 14|2Pe.2:14]], [[james 3 17|Jas.3:17]] (cf. Pr, l.with).† (AS)
μεστόω, -ῶ (μεστός), [in LXX: 3Ma.5:1 3Mac 5:10 * ;] to fill: pass., with genitive of thing(s), [[acts 2 13|Act.2:13.]]† (AS)

μετά (before vowel μετ᾽; on the neglect of elision in certain cases, V. WH, App., 146 b), prep. with genitive, accusative (in poet, also with dative), [in LXX for אַחַד ,עִם ,אֵת, etc.]. I. C. genitive, 1. among, amid: [[mark 1 13|Mrk.1:13]], [[luke 22 37|Luk.22:37]] (LXX, ἐν) 24:5, [[john 18 5|Jhn.18:5]], al.; διωγμῶν, [[mark 10 30|Mrk.10:30.]] 2. Of association and companionship, with (in which sense it gradually superseded σύν, than which it is much more frequently in NT; cf. Bl., §42, 3): with genitive of person(s), [[matthew 8 11|Mat.8:11 20:20]] [[mark 1 29|Mrk.1:29 3:7]] [[luke 5 30|Luk.5:30]], [[john 3 22|Jhn.3:22]], [[galatians 2 1|Gal.2:1]], al. mult.; εἶναι μετά, [[matthew 5 25|Mat.5:25]], [[mark 3 14|Mrk.3:14]], al.; metaphorically, of divine help and guidance, [[john 3 2|Jhn.3:2]], [[acts 7 9|Act.7:9]], [[philippians 4 9|Php.4:9]], al.; opposite to εἶναι κατά, [[matthew 12 30|Mat.12:30]], [[luke 11 23|Luk.11:23]]; in Hellenistic usage (but see M, Pr., 106, 246f.), πολεμεῖν μετά = cl. π., with dative, to wage war against (so LXX for נִלְחַם עִם, [[1-kings 17 33|1Ki.17:33]]), [[revelation 2 16|Rev.2:16]], al.; with genitive of thing(s), χαρᾶς, [[matthew 13 20|Mat.13:20]], [[mark 4 16|Mrk.4:16]], al.; ὀργῆς, [[mark 3 5|Mrk.3:5]], al. II. C. accusative, 1. of place, behind, after: [[hebrews 9 3|Heb.9:3.]] 2. Of time, after: [[matthew 17 1|Mat.17:1]], [[mark 14 1|Mrk.14:1]], [[luke 1 24|Luk.1:24]], [[acts 1 5|Act.1:5]], [[galatians 1 18|Gal.1:18]], al.; μετὰ τοῦτο, [[john 2 12|Jhn.2:12]], al.; ταῦτα, Mrk.16:[12], [[luke 5 27|Luk.5:27]], [[john 3 22|Jhn.3:22]], al; with inf. artic. (BL, §71, 5; 72, 3), [[matthew 26 32|Mat.26:32]], [[mark 1 14|Mrk.1:14]], al. III. In composition, 1. of association or community: μεταδίδωμι, μετέχω, etc. 2. Exchange or transference: μεταλλάσσω, μετοικίζω, etc. 3. after: μεταμέλομαι. (AS)

μετα-βαίνω [in LXX: Wis.7:27 19:19, 2Ma.6:1 2Mac 6:9 2Mac 6:24 * ;] to pass over from one place to another : [[matthew 17 20|Mat.17:20]], [[luke 10 7|Luk.10:7]]; with reference to the point of departure only, to withdraw, depart: [[matthew 8 34|Mat.8:34 11:1 12:9 15:29]], [[john 7 3|Jhn.7:3]], [[acts 18 7|Act.18:7]]; of removal from this life, ἐκ τ. κότμου πρὸς τ. Πατέρα, [[john 13 1|Jhn.13:1;]] metaphorically, ἐκ τ. θανάτου εἰς τ. ζωήν, [[john 5 24|Jhn.5:24]], [[1-john 3 14|1Jn.3:14]].† (AS)
μετα-βάλλω [in LXX chiefly for הָפַךְ ;] to turn about, change. Pass. and mid., to turn oneself about; metaphorically, to change one's mind: [[acts 28 6|Act.28:6.]]† (AS)

μετ-άγω [in LXX: 3Ki.8:47-48, [[2-chronicles 6 37|2Ch.6:37]] (שָׁבָה) [[2-chronicles 36 3|2Ch.36:3]] (סוּר hi.), 1Es.1:45 [[esther 2 10|Est.2:10]] [[esther 5 69|Est.5:69]], [[esther 8 17|Est.8:17]], Sir prol.16 Sir.10:8, 2Ma.1:33 * ;] 1. in Xen., Plut., and later writers, to transfer, transport (so LXX). 2. In sense other­wise unknown (see Hort, in l), to turn about, direct: [[james 3 3|Jas.3:3-4.]]† (AS)

μετα-δίδωμι [in LXX: [[proverbs 11 29|Pro.11:29]] (שָׁבַר hi.), Wis.7:13, al. ;] to give a share of, impart: with dative of person(s) and accusative of thing(s) (in cl. more freq., with genitive part., but accusative of that which is imparted, whether part or whole, so here, see Bl., § 36, 1), [[romans 1 11|Rom.1:11]], [[1-thessalonians 2 8|1Th.2:8]], and (with ellipse of accusative) [[luke 3 11|Luk.3:11;]] with dative of person(s), [[ephesians 4 28|Eph.4:28;]] absol., ὁ μεταδιδούς, [[romans 12 8|Rom.12:8.]]† (AS)

μετά-θεσις, -εως, ἡ (μετατίθημι) [in LXX: 2Ma.11:24 * ;] 1. change of position, removal : [[hebrews 11 5|Heb.11:5.]] 2. change, as of that which has been established : [[hebrews 7 12|Heb.7:12 12:27]].† (AS)

μετ-αίρω [in LXX: 4Ki.16:17 25:11, [[psalms 80 8|Psa.80:8]], [[proverbs 22 28|Pro.22:28]] (סוּר hi., גָּלָה hi., etc.)* ;] 1. trans., to remove (LXX, ll. with). 2. (not cl.) to depart: [[matthew 13 53|Mat.13:53 19:1]] (cf. Aq.: [[genesis 12 9|Gen.12:9]]).† (AS)

μετα-καλέω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[hosea 11 1|Hos.11:1-2]] (קָרָא), I [[esther 1 50|Est.1:50]] * ;] to call from one place to another. Mid., to send for: with accusative, [[acts 7 14|Act.7:14 10:32 20:17 24:25]].† (AS)

μετα-κινέω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 19 14|Deu.19:14]] (סוּג hi.), [[isaiah 54 10|Isa.54:10]] (מוֹט), etc. ;] trans., to move away, remove (ὅρια, Deu, l.with). Mid., to remove oneself, remove, shift: metaphorically, ἀπὸ τ. ἐλπίδος, [[colossians 1 23|Col.1:23.]]† (AS)

μετα-λαμξάνω [in LXX: [[esther 5 1|Est.5:1]], Wis.18:9; 4Ma.12:1-19 * ;] to have or get a share of, partake of: with genitive of thing(s), [[2-timothy 2 6|2Ti.2:6]], [[hebrews 6 7|Heb.6:7 12:10]]; τροφῆς, [[acts 2 46|Act.2:46 27:33-34]]; with accusative of thing(s) (of the whole), to get: καιρόν, [[acts 24 25|Act.24:25]] (see Bl., § 36, 1; MM, xvi).† (AS)
μετά-λημψις (Rec. -ληψις), -εως, ἡ (μεταλαμβάνω) participation, taking, receiving: of food, [[1-timothy 4 3|1Ti.4:3.]]† (AS)

μετ-αλλάσσω [in LXX: [[esther 2 7|Est.2:7]] (מוּת), [[esther 2 20|Est.2:20]], 1Es.1:31 [[esther 1 2|Est.1:2]] Mac.9 * ;] 1. to exchange: τ. ἀλήθειαν . . . ἐν τ. ψεύδει, the truth for a lie (see Bl., § 36, 8), Rom_1:25. 2. to change: with accusative before εἰς, Rom_1:26 (ἀλλάσσω).† (AS)

μετα-μέλομαι [in LXX chiefly for נָהַם: ni. ;] depon., pass., to regret, repent one: [[matthew 21 30|Mat.21:30, 32 27:3]], [[2-corinthians 7 8|2Co.7:8]], [[hebrews 7 21|Heb.7:21]]" (LXX) † SYN.: μετανοέω, to change one's mind, repent. On the distinc­tion, difficult to maintain by usage, between these words, see Thayer, see word; Tr., Syn., § lxix (AS)

μετα-μορφόω, -ῶ [in Sm.: [[psalms 34 1|Psa.34:1]] * ;] to transform, trans­figure: pass., of Christ's transfiguration, [[matthew 17 2|Mat.17:2]], [[mark 9 2|Mrk.9:2]] (cf. μή, subjective negative particle, used where the negation depends on a condition or hypothesis, expressed or understood, as distinct from οὐ, which denies absolutely. μή is used where one thinks a thing is not, as distinct from an absolute negation. As a general rule, οὐ negatives the indic, μή the other moods, incl, ptcp. [In LXX for אֵין ,אַיִן ,אַל ] I. As a neg. adv., not; 1. with ref. to thought or opinion: [[john 3 18|Jhn.3:18]], [[titus 1 11|Tit.1:11]], [[2-peter 1 9|2Pe.1:9]]. 2. In delib. questions, with subjc. (M, Pr., 185): [[mark 12 14|Mrk.12:14]], [[romans 3 8|Rom.3:8]]. 3. In conditional and final sentences, after εἰ, ἐάν, ἄν, ἵνα, ὅπως: [[matthew 10 14|Mat.10:14]], [[mark 6 11|Mrk.6:11 12:19]], [[luke 9 5|Luk.9:5]], [[john 6 50|Jhn.6:50]], [[romans 11 25|Rom.11:25]], al. 4. C. inf. (see M, Pr., 234f., 239, 255), (a) after verbs of saying, etc.: [[matthew 2 12|Mat.2:12 5:34]], [[mark 12 18|Mrk.12:18]], [[acts 15 38|Act.15:38]], [[romans 2 21|Rom.2:21]], al.; (b) with artic. inf.: after a prep., [[matthew 13 5|Mat.13:5]], [[mark 4 5|Mrk.4:5]], [[acts 7 19|Act.7:19]], [[1-corinthians 10 6|1Co.10:6]], al.; without a prep., [[romans 14 13|Rom.14:13]], [[2-corinthians 2 1|2Co.2:1, 13]] [[1-thessalonians 4 6|1Th 4:6]]; (with) in sentences expressing consequence, after ὥστε: [[matthew 8 28|Mat.8:28]], [[mark 3 20|Mrk.3:20]], [[1-corinthians 1 7|1Co.1:7]], [[2-corinthians 3 7|2Co.3:7]], al. 5. C. ptcp. (see M, Pr., 231f., 239), in hypothetical references to persons of a certain character or description: [[matthew 10 28|Mat.10:28 12:30]], [[luke 6 49|Luk.6:49]], [[john 3 18|Jhn.3:18]], [[romans 4 5|Rom.4:5]], [[1-corinthians 7 38|1Co.7:38]], [[1-john 3 10|1Jn.3:10]], al.; where the person or thing being definite, the denial is a matter of opinion: [[john 6 64|Jhn.6:64]], [[1-corinthians 1 28|1Co.1:28 4:7, 18]], [[2-corinthians 5 21|2Co.5:21]], al.; where the ptcp. has a concessive, causal or conditional force, if, though, because not: [[matthew 18 25|Mat.18:25]], [[luke 2 45|Luk.2:45]], [[john 7 49|Jhn.7:49]], [[acts 9 26|Act.9:26]], [[romans 2 14|Rom.2:14 5:13]], [[2-corinthians 3 14|2Co.3:14]], [[galatians 6 9|Gal.6:9]], Ju 5; where the ptcp. has a descriptive force (being such as), not: [[acts 9 9|Act.9:9]], [[romans 1 28|Rom.1:28]], [[1-corinthians 10 33|1Co.10:33]], [[galatians 4 8|Gal.4:8]], [[hebrews 12 27|Heb.12:27]], al. 6. μή prohibitive, in indep. sentences, (a) with subjc. praes., 1 of person(s) pl.: [[galatians 5 26|Gal.5:26 6:9]], [[1-thessalonians 5 6|1Th.5:6]], [[1-john 3 18|1Jn.3:18]]; (b) with imperat. praes., usually where one is bidden to desist from what has already begun (cf. M, Pr., 122ff.): [[matthew 7 1|Mat.7:1]], [[mark 5 36|Mrk.5:36]], [[luke 6 30|Luk.6:30]], [[john 2 16|Jhn.2:16 5:45]], [[acts 10 15|Act.10:15]], [[romans 11 18|Rom.11:18]], [[james 2 1|Jas.2:1]], [[revelation 5 5|Rev.5:5]], al.; (with) forbidding that which is still future: with imperat. aor., 3 of person(s), [[matthew 24 18|Mat.24:18]], [[mark 13 15|Mrk.13:15]], [[luke 17 31|Luk.17:31]], al.; with subjc. aor., 2 of person(s), [[matthew 3 9|Mat.3:9 10:26]], [[mark 5 7|Mrk.5:7]], [[luke 6 29|Luk.6:29]], [[john 3 7|Jhn.3:7]], [[romans 10 6|Rom.10:6]], al.; (d) with optative, in wishes: [[2-timothy 4 16|2Ti.4:16]] (LXX); μὴ γένοιτο (see M, Pr., 194; Bl., §66, 1), [[luke 20 16|Luk.20:16]], [[romans 3 3|Rom.3:3]], al.; μή τις, [[mark 13 5|Mrk.13:5]], al. II. As a conj., 1. after verbs of fearing, caution, etc., that, lest, perhaps (M, Pr., 192f.): with subjc. praes., [[hebrews 12 15|Heb.12:15;]] with subjc. aor., [[matthew 24 4|Mat.24:4]], [[mark 13 5|Mrk.13:5]], [[luke 21 8|Luk.21:8]], [[acts 13 40|Act.13:40]], [[galatians 5 15|Gal.5:15]], al.; ὅρα μή (see M, Pr., 124, 178), elliptically, [[revelation 19 10|Rev.19:10 22:9]]; with indic, fut. (M, Pr., l.with), [[colossians 2 8|Col.2:8.]] 2. in order that not: with subjc. aor., [[mark 13 36|Mrk.13:36]], [[2-corinthians 8 20|2Co.8:20 12:6]]. III. μηλωτή, -ῆς, ἡ (μῆλον, a sheep or goat) [in LXX for אַדֶּרֶת, 3Ki.19:13 19:19, [[2-kings 2 8|4Ki.2:8 2:13-14]] * ;] a sheepskin: [[hebrews 11 37|Heb.11:37.]]† (AS)

μήν genitive, μηνός, ὁ, [in LXX very frequently for חֹדֶשׁ, [[genesis 7 11|Gen.7:11]], al.; a few times for יֶרַח ;] a month: [[luke 1 24|Luk.1:24, 26 1:36, 56 4:25]], [[acts 7 20|Act.7:20 18:11 19:8 20:3 28:11]], [[james 5 17|Jas.5:17]], [[revelation 9 5|Rev.9:5, 10 9:15 11:2 13:5 22:2]]; pl., of the festival of the new moon (cf. [[isaiah 66 23|Isa.66:23]]), [[galatians 4 10|Gal.4:10]].† (AS)

μηνύω [in LXX: 2Ma.3:7 2Mac 6:11 2Mac 14:37, 3Ma.3:28, 4Ma.4:3 * ;] to disclose, declare, make known: [[luke 20 37|Luk.20:37]], [[1-corinthians 10 28|1Co.10:28]]; in forensic sense, to inform, report: [[john 11 57|Jhn.11:57;]] pass., with dative of person(s), [[acts 23 30|Act.23:30.]]† (AS)

μὴ οὐκ, see: μή, III. μή, subjective negative particle, used where the negation depends on a condition or hypothesis, expressed or understood, as distinct from οὐ, which denies absolutely. μή is used where one thinks a thing is not, as distinct from an absolute negation. As a general rule, οὐ negatives the indic, μή the other moods, incl, ptcp. [In LXX for אֵין ,אַיִן ,אַל ] I. As a neg. adv., not; 1. with ref. to thought or opinion: [[john 3 18|Jhn.3:18]], [[titus 1 11|Tit.1:11]], [[2-peter 1 9|2Pe.1:9]]. 2. In delib. questions, with subjc. (M, Pr., 185): [[mark 12 14|Mrk.12:14]], [[romans 3 8|Rom.3:8]]. 3. In conditional and final sentences, after εἰ, ἐάν, ἄν, ἵνα, ὅπως: [[matthew 10 14|Mat.10:14]], [[mark 6 11|Mrk.6:11 12:19]], [[luke 9 5|Luk.9:5]], [[john 6 50|Jhn.6:50]], [[romans 11 25|Rom.11:25]], al. 4. C. inf. (see M, Pr., 234f., 239, 255), (a) after verbs of saying, etc.: [[matthew 2 12|Mat.2:12 5:34]], [[mark 12 18|Mrk.12:18]], [[acts 15 38|Act.15:38]], [[romans 2 21|Rom.2:21]], al.; (b) with artic. inf.: after a prep., [[matthew 13 5|Mat.13:5]], [[mark 4 5|Mrk.4:5]], [[acts 7 19|Act.7:19]], [[1-corinthians 10 6|1Co.10:6]], al.; without a prep., [[romans 14 13|Rom.14:13]], [[2-corinthians 2 1|2Co.2:1, 13]] [[1-thessalonians 4 6|1Th 4:6]]; (with) in sentences expressing consequence, after ὥστε: [[matthew 8 28|Mat.8:28]], [[mark 3 20|Mrk.3:20]], [[1-corinthians 1 7|1Co.1:7]], [[2-corinthians 3 7|2Co.3:7]], al. 5. C. ptcp. (see M, Pr., 231f., 239), in hypothetical references to persons of a certain character or description: [[matthew 10 28|Mat.10:28 12:30]], [[luke 6 49|Luk.6:49]], [[john 3 18|Jhn.3:18]], [[romans 4 5|Rom.4:5]], [[1-corinthians 7 38|1Co.7:38]], [[1-john 3 10|1Jn.3:10]], al.; where the person or thing being definite, the denial is a matter of opinion: [[john 6 64|Jhn.6:64]], [[1-corinthians 1 28|1Co.1:28 4:7, 18]], [[2-corinthians 5 21|2Co.5:21]], al.; where the ptcp. has a concessive, causal or conditional force, if, though, because not: [[matthew 18 25|Mat.18:25]], [[luke 2 45|Luk.2:45]], [[john 7 49|Jhn.7:49]], [[acts 9 26|Act.9:26]], [[romans 2 14|Rom.2:14 5:13]], [[2-corinthians 3 14|2Co.3:14]], [[galatians 6 9|Gal.6:9]], Ju 5; where the ptcp. has a descriptive force (being such as), not: [[acts 9 9|Act.9:9]], [[romans 1 28|Rom.1:28]], [[1-corinthians 10 33|1Co.10:33]], [[galatians 4 8|Gal.4:8]], [[hebrews 12 27|Heb.12:27]], al. 6. μή prohibitive, in indep. sentences, (a) with subjc. praes., 1 of person(s) pl.: [[galatians 5 26|Gal.5:26 6:9]], [[1-thessalonians 5 6|1Th.5:6]], [[1-john 3 18|1Jn.3:18]]; (b) with imperat. praes., usually where one is bidden to desist from what has already begun (cf. M, Pr., 122ff.): [[matthew 7 1|Mat.7:1]], [[mark 5 36|Mrk.5:36]], [[luke 6 30|Luk.6:30]], [[john 2 16|Jhn.2:16 5:45]], [[acts 10 15|Act.10:15]], [[romans 11 18|Rom.11:18]], [[james 2 1|Jas.2:1]], [[revelation 5 5|Rev.5:5]], al.; (with) forbidding that which is still future: with imperat. aor., 3 of person(s), [[matthew 24 18|Mat.24:18]], [[mark 13 15|Mrk.13:15]], [[luke 17 31|Luk.17:31]], al.; with subjc. aor., 2 of person(s), [[matthew 3 9|Mat.3:9 10:26]], [[mark 5 7|Mrk.5:7]], [[luke 6 29|Luk.6:29]], [[john 3 7|Jhn.3:7]], [[romans 10 6|Rom.10:6]], al.; (d) with optative, in wishes: [[2-timothy 4 16|2Ti.4:16]] (LXX); μὴ γένοιτο (see M, Pr., 194; Bl., §66, 1), [[luke 20 16|Luk.20:16]], [[romans 3 3|Rom.3:3]], al.; μή τις, [[mark 13 5|Mrk.13:5]], al. II. As a conj., 1. after verbs of fearing, caution, etc., that, lest, perhaps (M, Pr., 192f.): with subjc. praes., [[hebrews 12 15|Heb.12:15;]] with subjc. aor., [[matthew 24 4|Mat.24:4]], [[mark 13 5|Mrk.13:5]], [[luke 21 8|Luk.21:8]], [[acts 13 40|Act.13:40]], [[galatians 5 15|Gal.5:15]], al.; ὅρα μή (see M, Pr., 124, 178), elliptically, [[revelation 19 10|Rev.19:10 22:9]]; with indic, fut. (M, Pr., l.with), [[colossians 2 8|Col.2:8.]] 2. in order that not: with subjc. aor., [[mark 13 36|Mrk.13:36]], [[2-corinthians 8 20|2Co.8:20 12:6]]. III. Interrogative, in hesitant questions (M, Pr., 170), or where a negative answer is expected: [[matthew 7 9|Mat.7:9, 10]], [[mark 2 19|Mrk.2:19]], [[john 3 4|Jhn.3:4]], [[romans 3 3|Rom.3:3 10:18, 19]], [[1-corinthians 1 13|1Co.1:13]], al.; μή τις, [[luke 22 35|Luk.22:35]], al.; before οὐ ([[romans 10 17|Rom.10:17]], al. in Pl.), expecting an affirm, ans.; οὐ μή, [[luke 18 7|Luk.18:7]], [[john 18 11|Jhn.18:11]]. IV. οὐ μή as emphatic negation (cf. M, Pr., 188, 190ff.; Bl. §64, 5), not at all, by no means: with indic, fut., [[matthew 16 22|Mat.16:22]], [[john 6 35|Jhn.6:35]], [[hebrews 10 17|Heb.10:17]], al.; with subjc. aor., [[matthew 24 2|Mat.24:2]], [[mark 13 2|Mrk.13:2]], [[luke 6 37|Luk.6:37]], [[john 13 8|Jhn.13:8]], [[1-corinthians 8 13|1Co.8:13]], al. (AS)

μήποτε (= μή ποτε, and so written in WH, exc. [[matthew 25 9|Mat.25:9]]), negative particle, related to οὔποτε as μή to οὐ. 1. As neg. particle, never: [[hebrews 9 17|Heb.9:17]] (R, mg., but see infr.; WH, txt., μή τότε). 2. As conjc., lest ever, lest haply (the idea of chance rather than of time seems to prevail in NT) : [[matthew 4 6|Mat.4:6]] (LXX) [[matthew 5 25|Mat.5:25 7:6 13:15]]" (LXX), [[matthew 13 29|Mat.13:29 15:32 27:64]], [[mark 4 12|Mrk.4:12]]" (LXX) [[mark 14 2|Mrk.14:2]], [[luke 4 11|Luk.4:11 12:58 14:12, 29]], [[acts 28 27|Act.28:27]]; after verbs of fearing or taking heed, [[luke 21 34|Luk.21:34]], [[hebrews 2 1|Heb.2:1 3:12 4:1]]; with ellipse of the verb or ptcp., [[luke 14 8|Luk.14:8]], [[acts 5 39|Act.5:39]]; in later writers (see M, Pr., 192 f.), perhaps, [[matthew 25 9|Mat.25:9.]] 3. As interrogative; (a) in direct questions, like μή, expecting a negative answer: [[john 7 26|Jhn.7:26]], [[hebrews 9 17|Heb.9:17]], (R, txt., cf. Westc., in l; but see supr.); (b) in indirect questions, whether haply, if haply: [[luke 3 15|Luk.3:15]], [[2-timothy 2 25|2Ti.2:25]].† (AS)
μήπω (μή πω, LTr., in Ro, l.with), adv., not yet: with ptcp., [[romans 9 11|Rom.9:11;]] with accusative and inf., [[hebrews 9 8|Heb.9:8.]]† (AS)

μήπως or μή πως (so WH), negative particle, 1. as conjc., lest haply: in final sentences, [[1-corinthians 9 27|1Co.9:27]], [[2-corinthians 2 7|2Co.2:7 9:4]]; after verbs of fearing or taking heed, [[1-corinthians 8 9|1Co.8:9]], [[2-corinthians 11 3|2Co.11:3 12:20]], [[galatians 4 11|Gal.4:11]]; with an ellipse of ptcp. (sc. φοβούμενος; cf. B1., § 65, 3; Burton, § 225), [[1-thessalonians 3 5|1Th.3:5]] (but see infr.). 2. As interrogative, whether haply: [[galatians 2 2|Gal.2:2]], [[1-thessalonians 3 5|1Th.3:5]] (cf. M, Th., in l, but see supr.).† μήπου (WH, μή που), lest anywhere, lest haply: [[acts 27 29|Act.27:29.]]† (AS)
μηρός, -oῦ, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for יָרֵךְ ;] the thigh: [[revelation 19 16|Rev.19:16.]]† (AS)

μή-τε negative particle, differing from οὔτε as μή from οὐ, neither, nor: μήτε . . . μήτε, neither . . . nor, [[matthew 11 18|Mat.11:18]], [[luke 7 33|Luk.7:33 9:3]], [[acts 23 12|Act.23:12, 21 27:20]], [[hebrews 7 3|Heb.7:3]]; μὴ (μηδὲ) . . . μήτε . . . μήτε, [[matthew 5 34|Mat.5:34, 36]], [[mark 3 20|Mrk.3:20]] T, [[acts 23 8|Act.23:8]], [[2-thessalonians 2 2|2Th.2:2]], [[1-timothy 1 7|1Ti.1:7]], [[james 5 12|Jas.5:12]], [[revelation 7 1|Rev.7:1]], 3.† (AS)

μήτηρ genitive, μητρός, ἡ, [in LXX chiefly for אֵם ;] mother: [[matthew 1 18|Mat.1:18 2:11]], al.; figuratively, of one who takes the place of a mother, ἰδοὺ, ἡ μ. μου, [[matthew 12 49|Mat.12:49]] (cf. [[matthew 12 50|Mat.12:50]], [[mark 3 35|Mrk.3:35]], [[john 19 27|Jhn.19:27]], [[romans 16 13|Rom.16:13]], [[1-timothy 5 2|1Ti.5:2]]); of a city, ἥτις ἐσὶν μ. ἡμῶν, [[galatians 4 26|Gal.4:26;]] symbolically of Babylon, ἡ μ. τ. πορνῶν, [[revelation 17 5|Rev.17:5]] (AS)

μή-τι interrog. particle, expecting a negative answer: [[matthew 7 16|Mat.7:16 26:22, 25]], [[mark 4 21|Mrk.4:21 14:19]], [[luke 6 39|Luk.6:39]], [[john 8 22|Jhn.8:22 18:35]], [[acts 10 47|Act.10:47]], [[2-corinthians 12 18|2Co.12:18]], [[james 3 11|Jas.3:11]]; in hesitant questions (see M, Pr., 170.), μ οὗτός ἐστιν, can this be, [[matthew 12 23|Mat.12:23]], [[john 4 29|Jhn.4:29]]; μ. ἄρα, [[2-corinthians 1 17|2Co.1:17;]] On εἰ μήτι ([[luke 9 13|Luk.9:13]], cf. Bl., § 65, 6), see: εἰ.† εἰ, conjunctive particle, used in conditions and in indirect questions. I. Conditional, if; 1. with indic, expressing a general assumption; (a) pres.: before indic, pres., [[matthew 11 14|Mat.11:14]], [[romans 8 25|Rom.8:25]], al.; before imperat., [[mark 4 23|Mrk.4:23 9:22]], [[john 15 18|Jhn.15:18]], [[1-corinthians 7 9|1Co.7:9]], al.; before fut. indic., [[luke 16 31|Luk.16:31]], [[romans 8 11|Rom.8:11]], al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, [[matthew 12 26|Mat.12:26]], [[romans 4 14|Rom.4:14]], al.; similarly, before impf., [[luke 17 6|Luk.17:6]], [[john 8 39|Jhn.8:39]]; before quæst., [[matthew 6 23|Mat.6:23]], [[john 5 47|Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46]], [[1-peter 2 20|1Pe.2:20]]; (b) fut.: [[matthew 26 33|Mat.26:33]], [[1-peter 2 20|1Pe.2:20]]; (with) pf.: [[john 11 12|Jhn.11:12]], [[romans 6 5|Rom.6:5]], al.; (d) aor.: [[luke 16 11|Luk.16:11 19:8]], [[john 13 32|Jhn.13:32, 18:23]], [[revelation 20 15|Rev.20:15]], al. 2. Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί: [[matthew 12 28|Mat.12:28]], [[john 7 4|Jhn.7:4]], [[romans 5 17|Rom.5:17]], al. 3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i). 4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: [[mark 15 44|Mrk.15:44]], [[1-john 3 13|1Jn.3:13]], al. 5. C. indic., as in LXX ([[numbers 14 3|Num.14:3]]o, [[1-samuel 14 45|1Ki.14:45]], al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): [[mark 8 12|Mrk.8:12]], [[hebrews 3 11|Heb.3:11]]" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX). 6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, to express a merely possible condition: [[acts 24 19|Act.24:19 27:39]], [[1-corinthians 14 10|1Co.14:10 15:37]], I Pe3:14, 17. II. Interrogative, if, whether. 1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., [[matthew 26 63|Mat.26:63]], [[mark 15 36|Mrk.15:36]], [[acts 19 2|Act.19:2]], [[2-corinthians 13 5|2Co.13:5]], al.; fut., [[mark 3 2|Mrk.3:2]], [[acts 8 22|Act.8:22]], al.; aor., [[mark 15 44|Mrk.15:44]], [[1-corinthians 1 16|1Co.1:16]], al.; with subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 194), [[philippians 3 12|Php.3:12.]] 2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, [[genesis 17 17|Gen.17:17]], al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), in direct questions: [[mark 8 23|Mrk.8:23]] (Tr., WH, txt.), [[luke 13 23|Luk.13:23, 22:49]], [[acts 19 2|Act.19:2]], al. III. With other particles. 1. εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, see: ἄρα, γε. 2. εἰ δὲ καί, but if also: [[luke 11 18|Luk.11:18;]] but even if, [[1-corinthians 4 7|1Co.4:7]], [[2-corinthians 4 3|2Co.4:3 11:16]]. 3. εἰ δὲ μή, but if not, but if otherwise: [[mark 2 21|Mrk.2:21, 22]] [[john 14 2|Jhn.14:2]], [[revelation 2 5|Rev.2:5]], al. 4. εἰ καί, if even, if also, although: [[mark 14 29|Mrk.14:29]], [[luke 11 8|Luk.11:8]], [[1-corinthians 7 21|1Co.7:21]], [[2-corinthians 4 16|2Co.4:16]], [[philippians 2 17|Php.2:17]], al. 5. καὶ εἰ, even if, see: καί 6. εἰ μή, if not, unless, except, but only: [[matthew 24 22|Mat.24:22]], [[mark 2 26|Mrk.2:26 6:5]], [[john 9 33|Jhn.9:33]], [[1-corinthians 7 17|1Co.7:17]] (only), [[galatians 1 19|Gal.1:19]] (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., Ja., xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), [[1-corinthians 14 5|1Co.14:5 15:2]], [[1-timothy 5 19|1Ti.5:19]]. 7. εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, Pr., 46), in oaths, surely ([[ezekiel 33 27|Eze.33:27]], al.): [[hebrews 6 14|Heb.6:14]]. 8. εἴ πως, if haply: [[acts 27 12|Act.27:12]], [[romans 1 10|Rom.1:10]]. 9. εἴτε . . . εἴτε, whether . . . or; [[romans 12 6|Rom.12:6-8]], [[1-corinthians 3 22|1Co.3:22 13:8]], al. (AS)
μή-τι-γε (μήτι γε, Rec., L; μή τι γε, Tr.), strengthened form of μήτι, let alone: i.e. according to context; (a) much less; (b) much more: [[1-corinthians 6 3|1Co.6:3.]]† (AS)
μή-τις Rec. for μή τις (see: μή יׇקְמְעָם, I, III, and cf. Thayer, see: μήτις) μή-τις Rec. for μή τις (see: μή יׇקְמְעָם, I, III, and cf. Thayer, see: μήτις) (AS)
μήτρα, -ας, ἡ (μήτμρ), [in LXX chiefly for רֶחֶם ;] the womb: [[luke 2 23|Luk.2:23]] (LXX), [[romans 4 19|Rom.4:19.]]† (AS)

μητρολῴας (Rec. -αλῴας, in cl., -αλοίας, see B1., § 3, 3; 6, 2), -ου, ὁ (μήτρρ + ἀλοιάω, to smite) (a) a matricide: [[1-timothy 1 9|1Ti.1:9]] (AV, R, txt., but see infr.); (b) a smiter of his mother: [[1-timothy 1 9|1Ti.1:9]] (R, mg., cf. [[exodus 21 15|Exo.21:15]], and see Ellic., CGT, in l).† (AS)
μητρό-πολις, -εως, ἡ [in LXX for אָב etc. ;] a metropolis, chief city: ITi, subscr. (Rec.).† (AS)

μία, see: εἷς. εἷς ιά, ἕν, genitive ἑνός, μιᾶς, ἑνός, cardinal numeral, one; 1. one, as opposite to many: [[matthew 25 15|Mat.25:15]], [[romans 5 12|Rom.5:12]], [[1-corinthians 10 8|1Co.10:8]], al.; as subst., [[romans 5 15|Rom.5:15]], [[ephesians 2 14|Eph.2:14]]; id. with genitive partit., [[matthew 5 19|Mat.5:19]], al.; before ἐκ (ἐξ), [[mark 14 18|Mrk.14:18]], [[john 6 8|Jhn.6:8]], al.; metaphorically, of union and concord, [[john 10 30|Jhn.10:30 17:11]], [[romans 12 4|Rom.12:4-5]], [[philippians 1 27|Php.1:27]]; ἀπὸ μιᾶς (B1., § 44, 1), [[luke 14 18|Luk.14:18;]] with neg., εἷς. . . οὐ (μή), more emphatic than οὐδείς, no one, none (cl.), [[matthew 5 18|Mat.5:18 10:29]], [[luke 11 46|Luk.11:46 12:6]]. 2. Emphatically, to the exclusion of others; (a) a single (one): [[matthew 21 24|Mat.21:24]], [[mark 8 14|Mrk.8:14]]; absol., [[1-corinthians 9 24|1Co.9:24]], al.; οὐδὲ εἷς, [[matthew 27 14|Mat.27:14]], [[john 1 3|Jhn.1:3]], [[romans 3 10|Rom.3:10]], al.; (b) one, alone: [[mark 2 7|Mrk.2:7 10:18]], [[luke 18 19|Luk.18:19]]; (with) one and the same: [[romans 3 30|Rom.3:30]], [[1-corinthians 3 8|1Co.3:8 11:5 12:11]], [[1-john 5 8|1Jn.5:8]]. 3. In late Gk., with weakened force, = τις or indef. art. (of. Heb. אֶחָד, [[genesis 22 13|Gen.22:13]], al.; see B1., § 45, 2; M, Pr., 96 f.): [[matthew 8 19|Mat.8:19 19:6]], [[revelation 8 13|Rev.8:13]], al.; εἷς τις (Bl., l.with), [[luke 22 50|Luk.22:50]], [[john 11 49|Jhn.11:49]] 4. Distributively: εἷς καστος (cl.), [[luke 4 40|Luk.4:40]], [[acts 2 6|Act.2:6]], al.; εἷς . . . καὶ εἷς (cl., εἷς μὲν . . . εἷς δέ), [[matthew 17 4|Mat.17:4]], [[mark 9 5|Mrk.9:5]], [[john 20 12|Jhn.20:12]], al. (cf. LXX and use of Heb. אֶחָד, [[exodus 17 12|Exo.17:12]], al); ὁ εἷς . . . ὁ ἕτερος (ἄλλος) = cl. ὁ μὲν (ἕτερος) . . . ὁ δέ (ἕτερος), [[matthew 6 24|Mat.6:24]], [[luke 7 41|Luk.7:41]], [[revelation 17 10|Rev.17:10]]; καθ᾽ εἷς, εἷς κ. είς (in which καθ᾽ is adverbial, or the expression formed from the analogy of ἕν καθ᾽ ἔν; M, Pr., 105), one by one, severally: [[mark 14 19|Mrk.14:19]], [[romans 12 5|Rom.12:5]], al.; εἷς τὸν ἕνα = ἀλλήλους (B1., 45, 2; M, Pr., 246), [[1-thessalonians 5 11|1Th.5:11.]] 5. As ordinal = πρῶτος (like Heb. אֶחָד; Bl., § 45, 1; M, Pr., 95 f.), first: [[matthew 28 1|Mat.28:1]], [[mark 16 2|Mrk.16:2]], al (AS)

μιαίνω [in LXX chiefly for טָמֵא ;] 1. to dye or stain. 2. to stain, defile, soil; (a) in physical sense; (b) in moral sense : [[titus 1 15|Tit.1:15]], [[hebrews 12 15|Heb.12:15]], Ju 8; (with) in ritual sense (cf. [[leviticus 22 5|Lev.22:5]], al.): [[john 18 28|Jhn.18:28]].† SYN.: μολύνω, to besmear, which also differs from μ. in that it is never used, as μ. in its primary meaning, in an honourable sense (cf. Tr., Syn., § xxxi) (AS)

μίασμα, -τος, τό (μιαίνω), chiefly in trag. and late writers; [in LXX: [[leviticus 7 8|Lev.7:8, 18]], (פִּגּוּל), [[jeremiah 32 34|Jer.32:34]] (שִׁקּוּץ), [[ezekiel 33 31|Eze.33:31]] (בֶּצַע), Jdth.9:2, 4 13:16, 1Ma.13:50 * ;] a stain, defilement: pl., [[2-peter 2 20|2Pe.2:20.]]† (AS)
μιασμός, -οῦ, ὁ (μιαίνω), [in LXX: Wis.14:26, 1Ma.4:43 * ;] 1. prop., the act of defiling. 2. = μίασμα (which see) : [[2-peter 2 10|2Pe.2:10]] (cf. Plut., Mor., 393c).† (AS)
μίγμα (LT, cl., μῖγμα; on the orthogr., see B1., § 3, 5), -τος, τό (μίγνυμι), [in LXX: Sir.38:8 * ;] a mixture: [[john 19 39|Jhn.19:39]] (ἕλιγμα, WH, R, mg.).† (AS)
